preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
For each test case, the number of elements n in the list a must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 50 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the list a must be between 0 and 50.
The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 100.

postconditions.description: The output must contain n + 1 strings for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s_i) <= 200 for s_i in s)
postconditions.description: Each string s_i must have a length between 1 and 200.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s[i][:a[i]]) == a[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The length of the longest common prefix of s_i and s_{i+1} must equal a_i for all i.
